verdict.rationale: Gusto documents Gus, a built-in AI assistant that gives personalized benefits guidance and builds a ready-to-submit benefits package, and also gives instant HR answers. That is real in-product delegation, but it is scoped to benefits and Q&A. The broader agentic payroll prep and reporting is delivered through external AI tools (Claude/ChatGPT) and the MCP server/CLI rather than a built-in assistant, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence of a built-in assistant that takes delegated tasks across payroll, HR and reporting, documentation of the assistant's scope and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
